data.description: an array with the values to be reduced.

segment_ids.description: an array with integer dtype that indicates the segments of `data` (along its leading axis) to be reduced. Values can be repeated and need not be sorted.

num_segments.default: set to be the minimum number of segments that
num_segments.description: optional, an int with nonnegative value indicating the number of segments. The default is set to be the minimum number of segments that would support all indices in ``segment_ids``, calculated as ``max(segment_ids) + 1``. Since `num_segments` determines the size of the output, a static value must be provided to use ``segment_max`` in a JIT-compiled function.
constraints: num_segments must be one of segment_max, JIT

indices_are_sorted.description: whether ``segment_ids`` is known to be sorted.

unique_indices.description: whether `segment_ids` is known to be free of duplicates.

bucket_size.description: size of bucket to group indices into. ``segment_max`` is performed on each bucket separately. Default ``None`` means no bucketing.

mode.description: a :class:`jax.lax.GatherScatterMode` value describing how out-of-bounds indices should be handled. By default, values outside of the range [0, num_segments) are dropped and do not contribute to the result.
constraints: mode must be one of jax.lax.GatherScatterMode

output.description: code:`(num_segments,) + data.shape[1:]` representing the segment maximums.
